outcome.Summary: Implemented `cmd/report/main.go` (package main) with `run(args, in, out)` and a `main` that prints errors to stderr and exits 1. It parses `--by region|product` (default region; also `--by=` form; invalid values error) and `--top N` (N ≥ 1; invalid errors), reads the CSV via encoding/csv with header-based column lookup (any order, extra columns allowed, missing required column → error naming it), parses qty (integer ≥ 0) and price (≤ 2 decimals → integer cents) with 1-based line numbers in errors, and writes groups sorted by revenue desc / name asc plus a TOTAL line over all rows, formatted with exactly 2 decimals. Added 16 tests in `cmd/report/main_test.go` covering the example, grouping, sorting/ties, --top semantics, missing-column and bad-value errors, reordered/extra columns, and formatting. Verified `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes and the binary reproduces the task's example output.
